equation_request.abstract: We present an idea to convert to a unitary quantum walk any open quantum walk which is defined on lattices as well as on finite graphs. This approach generalizes to the domain of open quantum walks (or quantum Markov chains) the framework introduced by Szegedy for quantizing Markov chains. For the unitary quantum walks formulated in this article, we define the probability and the mean probability of finding the walk at a node, then derive the asymptotic mean probability.

specification.problem: Convert an open quantum walk (OQW, quantum Markov chain) on a graph into a unitary quantum walk generalizing Szegedy's quantization of Markov chains, and define the node probability, mean (time-averaged) probability, and its asymptotic limit. The abstract gives no explicit construction.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Background-level reconstruction of (i) the OQW update rule, (ii) the standard Szegedy walk for a classical Markov chain, and (iii) the definition of node probability and Cesaro mean probability, on a tiny assumed instance (2-node graph with 2-dim internal space). The paper-specific OQW-to-unitary conversion, its Kraus-operator-dependent isometry, and the asymptotic mean probability result are outside scope and not reconstructed.
